tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam can rgya mtsho'i mchod bstod kyi rim pa nyi tshe ba nor bu 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// mngon rtogs hūm̐ ka yig gang du'ang mi gnas chos dbyings mdangs// snod bcud dkyil 'khor chen por grub pa'i dbus// hūm̐ dang gri gug zer gyis gdug pa bsad// sangs rgyas mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus las sku// kha dog mi bzad mun pa cher gnag pa// 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa'i du bas dkris// drag shul cher khros zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar// dpa' sgeg 'jigs sogs nyams dang 'gyur ba'i gter// ga shal 'dzag pa'i mgo bo lnga bcu 'phyang*// gug kyed cod pan phyag rgya drug gis brgyan// gdug pa'i sbrul 'khril mi dang glang chen dang*// stag gis pags pa rlon pa gos su gyon// nga ro hūm̐ gis bdud bzhi dpa' 'khums pa'i// steng du dpa' bo'i rol pa chen pos 'gying*// phyag bzhi be ta ro langs lce'i ral gri// thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ dar dpyangs ldan pa bsnams// ca re sku dang skad cig mi 'bral bar// kun tu sna tshogs gzugs ston tsaṇ+ḍika /skem zhing sbeg pa mthing nag gtum pa'i bzhin// phyag na ral gri mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin// cha byad mi'u thung khros pa'i khro bo ste// sgrol byed gsod byed rngam byed bdud mo rnams// dgra la rngam pa'i rkan rdeb bya rog gdong*// zhabs brdabs khams gsum srid pa g.yo zhing bsgul// ji ltar sred skyed dug gsum nyon mongs sbal// gnod sbyin ljang nag khrag gi ral pa can// 'jig rten phung bar byed pa'i rā hu la// sha za mthu bo seng ge'i gdong pa can// nya ltar gcer mo gar 'khyug sgo mtshams ma// ro langs brgya dang nag stong sha za 'bum// ma mo sa ya gnod spyin khri dang ni// dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lngar bcas pas bskor// spyan 'dren hūm̐ ta thā ga ta rnams kyi skal bzang zhing*// chos bzhin skyong ba'i mgon po khyod yin pas// snyigs ma lnga bdo 'phrin las mdzad pa yi// dus lags btang snyoms mi 'tshal 'dir gshegs shig

/tha ma'i srid par byang chub shing drung du// me tog gzhu can g.yul du rlag byed pa'i// dpa' bo rnams kyi dmag gi dpon po khyod// nyams pa bsgral phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no// da lta srid gsum khams kyi dregs pa can// ci mchis khyod kyi bran tshogs mdun du bdar// bya gcan klad dang bshul du rjes 'brang can// dad pas spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// bzhugs gsol na rā ya dang biṣ+ṇu la sogs pa// dbang po sder bcas mthun mnan khrir bzhugs nas// dam bzhag sngon gyi zhal bzhes rjes su dgongs mdzod ces// phyag 'tshal bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bskur pa ra mi tā'i sras mchog rigs lnga yis// bdud rtsi lnga yi bum pas dbang bskur te// mthu stobs nus pa kun la mnga' bsgyur phyir// rgyas gdab gnyis med bde ba chen por rgyas btab po// mchod pa hūm̐ pha rol mo brgyud srid pa'i rtsa bcad pa'i// dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho'i ar+ghaṃ sgreng*// pho rgyud dung can gtub pa'i zla ba'i rgyun// zhal dang zhabs bsil rkyen du legs par sbyar// phyi ba mos ma reg me tog gsur chen spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas re re yang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan bzhin du// gang dgyes de der rdzu ba mchod par 'bul// nang ma rabs dkar byang du bris dmar byang btab// ting 'dzin sngags rgya thun gyis bsad byas pa'i// sha rus rir spungs khrag ni mtshor bskyil ba'i// ba liṃ mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ kha hi// gsang ba tsa ru'i bzar 'os myos byed rnam pa brgyad// sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin lnga yi tshogs// oṃ gyis rab sbyangs āḥsbar hūm̐ gis spel// hoḥyis bdud rtsir bzhu ba'i phud 'bul lo// de kho na tsha ba lte ba'i gtum mo'i ye shes mes// bde ba chen po'i he ru ka bskul te// snyoms zhugs sbyor ba'i mtshams 'ong dga' ba'i cha// gtsug tor nam mkhar gang bas mchod par bgyi//

'dzab mchod dzaḥyis dkyil 'khor bzhi yi nang du bkug /hūm̐ gis smin byed dbang bzhi'i zhags pas bcings// baṃ gyis rim gnyis lam du legs bsdams te// hoḥyis thams cad rdo rje'i sa la mnyed// oṃ badz+ra kā wu wa wa pa shā ya/ ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bskang bshags wa ler lha gsal 'dzab zlos phyag rgya bstan// rten gsum tshogs zhing mthun pa'i mchod rdzas mod// rtsa ltung yan lag bcas pas ma gos pas// khyod thugs bskang zhing nyams pa mthol lo bshags// phyi sku'i bstod pa hūm̐ zhwa ltar 'jig rten yas mthar mgon po'i tshogs// ha cang dregs nas gdul dka' 'dul ba la// sangs rgyas kun gyi nus pas khyod bsgrubs tshe// de dag brgal 'bog sangs nas bran du gyur// nang gsang bstod za po rtag sogs phyin ci log bkag nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung dbu ma'i bshul ston par// snying po gsang sngags rig pa gzungs kyi tshogs// yan lag drug cus nye bar longs spyod mdzad// gsang ba thugs bstod 'a le tsam du zag med chos kyi sde// ji snyed khyod thugs rnam pa thams cad pas// zhib mor dpyad pa sangs rgyas kho na'i yul// 'on kyang chos rnams kun dang ro mnyam mo// de kho nyid ro mnyam la bstod pa ya mtshan spros min spros pa kun tu snang*// zhi min zhi dang 'khor min 'khor ba dang*// lam min lam sogs 'gal ba gcig 'du bas// bsam mi khyab la bdag ni phyag 'tshal bstod// gzu dpang rwa ltar bstod kyang tsher ltar 'og tu zug /phan btags lan du bsam sbyor gnod kho na// 'di 'dra bdag gis bzod kyang srungs mar brnyas// bsgral ba'i dus la bab bo ma g.yel zhig/ chad rdo la ba dkar 'dra chos bzang 'dun sa ru// dkar po'i lha dang de yi phyogs rnams kyis// bstod tshe ji ltar khas blangs da bskul gyis// bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho las la 'chos// bskul sha za gtum po thams cad shul du 'brangs// lha srin sde brgyad thams cad gso sgra ldir// sprul pa ci yang rdzu bas gnam sa khyab// de 'dra'i mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yo//

bzlog pa sa la mnan dang chur gtad me la bsreg /rlung la 'khor lor bskor dang 'byung ba bzhi'i// rkyen gyis byad du stems pa ci mchis pa// byad mkhan nag po rang la bzlog cig bsgyur// gtor mnan ha ha bgegs su bdud rtsi mnyam pa nyid// snang tshad mgon po'i sku la grags pa gsung*/ dran tshad ye shes chen po'i rol pa yin// de phyir rdo rje'i glu len bro brdung ngo*// mnga' gsol a la la zhes sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// bstod cing bkur dang bsngags pa ci yang mdzad// srid gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi dad shugs la// 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'jug pa'i mnga' yang gsol// rjes chog 'di ltar mchod la lhag chad byung ba bskong*// dus 'di nas gzung byang chub bar du skyobs// deng nas bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad la// mgon po 'khor bcas gnyis med thim gyur cig/ blo bzang dga' bos bskul ba ltar du/ pad+ma dkar pos bgyis pa'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dhar+m+māḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ hūm̐ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhir// khrag zhag klad mtsho rba rlabs g.yo ba'i klong*// gnam lcags zhun sbyar keng rus lhun po'i spor// sna tshogs rdo rje las 'phros rwa gur dbus// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan zhing*// 'dod snam rtsig pa pha gu dra ba dang*// shar bu bya 'dab pu shus dbus 'phyur bu// tog bcas rin chen las grub de'i nang du// thod pa skam rlon khrag zhag gis brtsigs pa// gru bzhi sgo dang lta babs dur khrod brgyad// chos 'byung 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi bdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje srin po khros pa'i gzugs// sbom thung gsus 'phyang yan lag gel la rags// mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgrog spyan gsum dmar// smin ma ag tshom skra ser thod pas brgyan// phyag bzhi g.yas na be 'bras ral gri dang*// g.yon pa thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul gyis spras// mi mgo'i do shal glang lpags stod du gsol// stag sham phyag rgya drug ldan sgeg pa'i nyams// ro steng dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs me rir bcas// g.yon du tsaṇ+ḍi ka ni phyag bzhi ma// ral gri dgra mgo mda' gzhu mdung bzung nas// btsan 'khyil 'dab bzhir rkan rdeb bya rog gdong*// mi'u thung khros gzugs gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rkang g.yas rdeb cing mdun zur mdog ljang ba'i// gnod sbyin bya gdong gri thod nor bus bkang*/

g.yon pa'i brang dang pus btsugs rā hu la// dud kha mgo bcu chu srin zhags pa dang*// mda' gzhu sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba g.yas// g.yon du gri thod 'dzin pa sha za'i gtso// seng ge'i gdong can mthing nag gar gyis rol// bya rgod khyung dang khwa ta 'ug gdong sgo// mtshams su phag khyi spyang ki stag mgo ma// gri gug thod 'dzin mthing nag thams cad kyang*// mi mgo ga shal zhing gos stag sham can// phyogs mtshams rgyug pa'i ro langs brgya po dang*// phyi snam nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri dang sgor// rgyal po sde bzhi btsan pa'i go gyon zhing*// phyi rol khor yug phyogs skyong lha chen dang*// klu dang gnod sbyin gza' dang rgyu skar dang*// 'jigs byed ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad// thams cad khros pa mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa cher khros pa// 'jigs byed chen po ma hā kā la khyod// sprul pa'i zhing du bstan bsrung kun gyi gtsor// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyis mnga' gsol bas// bstan pa bsrung phyir deng 'dir spyan 'dren na// dregs pa'i bka' sdod 'khor bcas sku bskyod la// bsil ba'i tshal nas myur bar 'dir gshegs zhes// mtshan nas bos so nag po bya rog ming*// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ sdom gsum gtsang ma'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// mang thos me tog rnam dpyod ge sar can// brtag dpyad mkhar rgyu bsam pa spos kyi sprin// sgom byung shes rab mchog gi sgron me sbar// dran pa'i gzungs gzung tshig don spos kyi chab// ma smad ting nge 'dzin gyi kha zas sbyar// mdo sde 'dul ba'i don rnams chos mngon la// bdar ba'i sgra dbyangs srid pa'i mthar grags shing*// snyan ngag gdangs bzang sdeb sbyor rgyun gyis sbrel// mngon brjod sna tshogs dar gyi phang phung can// brda sprod ya lad zlos gar phub ldan zhing*// yid ches grags dang dngos stobs las grub pa'i// bsgrub dang sun 'byin rno ba'i mtshon cha dang*// thub dbang bzhed don tshig rgyan du spel ba'i// rtsom pa'i spyan gzigs rgya mtshos dam can rnams// mchod pas thugs dam gnyan po skongs gyur cig

/oṃ las nam mkha' dang mnyam thod pa'i snod// āḥlas gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// ri rab dang mnyam zhu ba rgya mtsho tsam// hūm̐ las babs pas ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ badz+ra kā wu wa wa pa shā ya ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣa a pash+tsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya a pa kā ri naṃ/ ya di pra dī dz+nyā sma ra sita dā i daṃ duṣ+ṭa na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ grīh+ṇa grīh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐/ hūm̐ he ru ka khyod zla ba bdud rtsir bsnyen// gzhom dka'i 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rgyal// gser sbyangs 'drar dran blo gros gter kun 'byed// ban+dhu dzi wa ka ltar yang dag bsgrubs// khams gsum dbang por bcas pa bran du 'du// 'khrugs pa'i char sprin 'drar shes phas rgol sgrol// yang na bdud bzhi'i gshed ma nyid du 'gyur// de ltar bstod pas bdag gi 'gal rkyen sol// legs bshad grwa 'dir blos gsal rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gnyis 'thung che la bung ba ltar 'dus nas// rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs kun la mkhas sbyangs pas// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan par rgyas par mdzod// dpal bkra shis mthong smon gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang pa'i ngag 'don du pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ/ suṃ bh+rūṃ zhu bas chos 'byung 'byung zhi'i dal// ri rab rwa gur rin chen gzhal med khang*// mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i nang du thod pa'i mkhar// gru gsum me rlung 'khrug pa'i khrag mtsho'i dbus// mthing nag hūm̐ las bcom ldan dud sol ma// nag po sprin 'dra khro gtum sbeg pa'i gzugs// mche gtsigs ljags 'dril mi ro rengs pa gsol// dmar ba'i spyan gsum bzlog gzigs zur phud can// lan bu g.yon 'khyil thod pa sbrul gyis brgyan// snyan gong dar nag ut+pal ro nye dang*// sbrul dang seng ge'i rna rgyan glang lpags gsol// phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis ral gri thod khrag g.yon// shak+ti tri shu bzung zhing phyag rgya drug

/khrag zhag lha min mgo yi do shal can// ba lang ko rlon re ldes smad dkris nas// klu dbang ska rags tsan 'khyil lcags sgrog 'chang*// gwa dmar bong bu'i steng du 'gying zhing sgeg /zur gsum gcer bu ral can snying khrag 'dzin// phyi snam nang phyogs dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi// gri thod 'dzin ma bdun yang bong bu zhon// phyogs bzhir seng ge stag spyang phag dang mtshams// bya rgod skyung ka dur bya bya gdong ma// dre'u bcibs shing gri thod 'dzin dang sgor// kaṃ ka'i gdong can mda' gzhu spu gri'i sbrul// nad rkyal g.yon pa thod khrag stag spyang spre'u// dred zhon khor yug ma mo 'bum gyi sde// dur khrod chas brgyan oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ sum cu rtsa bdun gnas kyis pho nya mo'i// tshogs kyi dbang phyug rigs ldan dud sol ma// dad dang gdung bas spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs la// drag shul chen po'i dgra bgegs 'joms par mdzod// dṛ ṣ+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// dam tshig me tog bskyed rim spos kyi dud// rdzogs pa'i mar me spyod pa'i dri chab dang*// 'bras bu'i zhal zas mchog gis mchod par bgyi// ha las thod pa'i gtor ma gser zhun ltar// hoḥlas dri bzang kun gyi 'byung khung dang*// hrīḥlas ro bcud lha rdzas las 'das pa'i// ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo i daṃ ba liṃ ta grīh+na grīh+na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ dhu yig gis brjod bdag nyid thabs kyi lhas// shes rab yum la rjes su chags bzhin pas// bsnyen pa'i tshul shes zhi sogs gang 'dod der// mod la brjod 'di 'ol phyir mi spobs mthu// maṃ yig nā ḍir nyi ma'i sde 'chings pas// nang gi lha mo khyod gnyis nyams brgya'i gar// nā da'i dbyangs sbyar khams gsum du bsgyur tshe// phung khams 'ja' tshon ston pa'ang sgyu ma'i zol// gā yig nyi zla sbyar ba sgra gcan khar// zos dus gsang ba'i ma mo khyod zhabs dran// sgo gsum dhu tī'i dbyings su thim gyur pa'i// mngon par byang chub yud kyis de la shar/

ṛ yig sgyu ma'i khams bzhi'i lha mo'i glus// stong bzhi'i mtha' las sad pa'i ye shes lus// slad nas yang dag mtha' dang nam gzhar yang*// mi phyed 'dod pa'i dngos grub sbyin khyod kyis// bshad pa pad+mo'i 'byung gnas 'di nyid du// mkhas pa ngang pa'i ded dpon kun bsdus nas// pad dkar bzhed pa'i dri bsung gis sim pa'i// dam chos mgrin rnga brdung bas rtag 'gengs mdzod//

'di yang grwa tshang ba'i kha ton du'o/// / dge bsnyen chen po smyo kha mchod par 'dod pas/ kyai/ gdong dmar yul gyi pha rol na// kha khra mon gyi tshu rol na// man+t+ra gañdza lha mo'i mkhar// zhing skyong ma mo'i gnas mchog nas// 'jig rten phung byed rā hu la// lhag pa khros pa'i mthu rtsal can// 'chi bdag bdud po mngon sum pa// nag po ti pa ra tsa ste// smyo kha'i rje btsan khyed la bdag /gsang ba'i mtshan nas 'bod lags na// bka' nyan lha 'dre gnyan po tshos// mdun bdar mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// nag po ti rā tsa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ kyai/ dang po kun bzang he ru ka /dregs mdzad phyag na rdo rjes khyod// ngan spyod sdig las bzlog byas te// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar bskos// bar du pad+ma nam snying dang*// ras chung rig 'dzin gnyan gyi bkas// dam pa'i zab rgyas gnyer gtad nas// chos bdag chen por dbang yang bskur// tha mar mtshungs med 'brug pa rje// slob mar bcas pas dam tshig chu// byin nas rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi// dgra lha gnyan po mnga' yang gsol// da lta sngags 'chang sgrub pa po// 'khor dang bcas pa'i mchod bshams nas// bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub byed pa'i// pho nyar mnga' gsol sa ma ya dzaḥ kyai/ mi gtsang thab sogs rkyen gang gis// khyed kyi sku gsung thugs rnyog pa'i// grib sel dam pa'i bsang 'di 'bul// phyin chad 'khor 'dir gnod ma mdzad// dgra mgo dbang po don dang snod// lhab lhub lda ldi'i mchog tu sbrel// gsur chen dud pa gdugs su phub// zhun chen sgron me'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// khong khrag dmar po'i ba dan 'phyar// srog dbugs bla tshe'i zas kyis bdar// mdzang mas mdzod du sogs pa'i nor// dpa' bo g.yul ngor chas pa'i rgyan// stag shar dgra la 'phen pa'i mtshon// sngags nag bsngo ba'i gtor ma glud// bon po yas gyer glu ma dbyangs// skyes bran na chung rtse ba'i dpyid// sa dang gnam la spyod dgu'i 'gro// dngul skyogs mdzes pa'i gser gyi skyems// 'phyar ba'i dar kun rngan du 'bul//

gtor ma bsangs sbyangs te dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs nas/ oṃ nag po ti pa ra tsa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gi 'gal rkyen sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs bcol lo// kyai/ me dpung nang nas khyod bzhengs tshe// khro bo sdig pa'i rwa ru can// ngams gnag lus po mig gis khengs// zer gyis phog shi mod la 'gyel// gnam lcags thog 'phang ser ba 'bebs// gser gyi 'khor lo dug sbrul bsnams// bdud rta bcibs nas 'dzam gling myul// skye dgu'i srog la rngam zas byed// mthu rtsal chen po khyod kyi dpung*// dregs pa'i lha srin bco brgyad lags// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// dug mtsho'i rba nas longs pa'i dus// stod ni srin po smad lto 'phye// sbrul nag dgu yi gdengs ka g.yo// kha rlangs dug gi sprin du gtibs// mdze rigs bco brgyad dgra la 'gyed// 'khor yang klu gdol nag pa'i tshogs// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// ri nag dbus nas bskyod tsa na// sbal mgo khrag gi mig dgu can// sdom sdig sbal sbrul rta zer 'phro// me dang dug gi sme bas brgyan// dgra bo 'dzin shes gtong mi shes// gnyan dang sa bdag khyod kyi bran// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// zhes brjod nas/ gats+tsha sa rang gnas su gshegs par gsol lo// kyai/ dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs dbus nas// pho nya 'dre mo ngan ne mo// rdo rje sna yon dpal gyi yum// mched 'khor bcas pa tshur gshegs shig /dza gad phud dang dmar gyi chol// sha rus nang khrol gtor tshogs dang*// dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas thams cad kyis// gsol lo mchod do bcol ba sgrubs// srin mo khros gzugs ri rab dang*// dmar ba srid gsum za ba'i me// mche gtsigs rngam pa gangs ri'i byin// spyan gsum gzir ba nyi ma mtshungs// phyag mtshan ma nges sna tshogs 'dzin// sgro thul dar dang g.yang gzhi gyon// lus can sgrol ba'i ging gcig ma// che zhe chen mo dgra la bh+yo// kyai/

srid pa'i bdag po chen po pa// sku lnga cho 'phrul cher ston pas// gdug pa'i lha 'dre tshogs pa'i rje// pe dkar 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes// zhim dgu'i chang phud rgya mtshor bskyil// bda' dgu'i zas kyi ri rab brtsigs// mkho dgu'i gser gyi ri bos bskor// yod dgu'i 'jig rten khams su 'bul// li yul lcang ra smug por khyod// bha ta hor gyi dgra lhar bkur// de nas brag dmar zan g.yang du// chos skyong chen por mnga' yang gsol/ gtsug lag khang rnams khyod la gtad// chos mdzad yongs kyi 'bangs su byas// bstan pa spel ba'i pho nyar mngags// dam nyams sgrol ba'i gshan par bskos// rnal 'byor dpon slob thams cad dang*// sbyin pa'i bdag po'i re ba skongs// bsam pa bsgrub la bcol ba mdzod// bar gcod dgra bgegs steng du zlog/ ces brjod cing gats+tshas gshegs par bya'o// de ltar gzhi bdag gsum gyi cho ga yang pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// / chos skyong dgyes pa skyed pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so//slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// kyai/ ka dag dbyings nas sku bskyod nas// dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs rje mdzad// dkar po lha yi dmag drangs nas// grong khyer sum brtsegs thal bar btags// kha sha li yi rgyal khams byon// sku lnga cho 'phrul dpag med bstan// bha ta hor gyi dgra lhar zhus// lcang ra smug po'i sgom grwar mchod// ga la'ang mthu rtsal 'don gzigs nas// mi rje srong lde btsan gyis// sprul pa'i dmag gis zan g.yang bkug /bod khams gnam sa khyod la gtad// nga rgyal dregs pa khyod kyi 'phrul// rgyal sras pad+mas zil mnan te// gzhan la gnod 'gyur gdug rtsub bkag /chos skyong rgyal por dbang bskur nas// ca cos srid pa bsgul nus pa'i// gnod sbyin chen po rtse ma ra// sna tshogs las mkhan blon por bskos// lha srin thams cad 'bangs su bzhag

/cha byad cir yang brdzus nas su// dam pa'i gtsug lag khang skyong zhing*// btsun pa bsrung slad rjes 'brangs nas// dad pas 'bod kyis 'dir gshegs shig /hūm̐ ja 'di yongs 'du'i dpag bsam dbang*// dgyes dgu mchod par 'ong 'dod nas// dri len dang 'grogs zil dngar bcud/ khyod mdun dang po'i pho nyar brdzangs// nya gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// gsar du 'dzag pa'i bdud rtsi bzhin// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar chang gi phud// gser phyes khebs pa skyems su 'bul/ ta ler dgra snying nas 'ong dang*// ling ga 'byung ba chen po'i rtsi// khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i rngams// 'jigs pa'i lbu 'phreng 'dzin pa bshams// tha dad mdog gi rnam bkra ba'i// me tog spos kyi dud pa dang*// mar me'i bla re ji snyed pa// logs la 'od mdzes dra ba rtsom// da lta tshangs pas dag byed chu// ga pur nyag ma 'thor ba gang*// 'chi med ri bo nas phab ste// khyed thugs bsil byed rkyen du sbyar// na ba gso zhing 'chi ba slong*// chad pa sbyor ba lha yi bshos// 'dod yon lnga ldan ri rab ni// dkar dmar nyi zla'i rna cha g.yo// pa tra me tog sprin ris dang*// cir yang snang ba'i za 'og dang*// rin chen 'dod dgu'i char ci yang*// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin las phab// pha rol srog gi gshed ma gri// mdung dang dgra sta mda' bo che// rno ba'i mtshon cha zhugs kyi rigs// ci dga' dbyar dus sprin bzhin bsnyer// ba lang thal dkar mche ba drug /'gying ba'i stabs kyis 'gro rnams dang*// rma bya'i mgrin ltar 'tsher ba'i rta// sprin gyi shugs ldan kun gyis mchod// ma rungs dug gi mche ba can// seng ge stag gzigs ce spyang dang*// gnam lcags mchu sder 'bar ba'i bya// mkha' la lding zhing gzhungs rnams 'bul// hūm̐ tsa ko ra ni nags nang na// zla 'od bdud rtsi 'thung bar 'dod// de bzhin bdag kyang khyod mthu las// bsam pa bsgrub la bsgug cing sdod// tsha ba'i me ltar khros pa'i spyan// dmar po dgra la gzigs mdzad na// de yul khang nor lus dang srog

/tha ma'i dus bzhin rjes med sreg /dzaḥzhes 'bod pa bye ba snyed// mod la gsan nas mdun nyil bas// sprul pa'i cho 'phrul mi bzad pa'i// ngo mtshar shes nas bdag gis bstod// wa ler bsams pa'i skad cig rer// khyod skus zhing khams kun bkang nas// rgyal ba mnyes pa'i mchod sprin 'god// sems dpa' chen por de yis nges// hūm̐ zhwa ni thib zhu dom slag gsol// zhags pa spu gri phyag na 'dzin// mon bus sna khrid glang chen bcibs// thog ser glog 'gyed brgya byin lags// za byed shān+ti ro gzan yum// dge bsnyen shel 'phreng sprul par ston// srog bdag bka' yi bya ra ba// g.yar dam skangs so 'phrin las sgrubs// 'a zhwa yul gyi ber zhwa gyon// rdo rje gsor zhing gseg shang thogs// stag gzig dom dred rol du 'dur// mdog nag seng zhon pu tra che// ya ma ro langs ma dang rol// dge slong dgra bcom sprul par ston// gshan pa bya khrid bka' sdod de// g.yar dam skongs so 'phrin las sgrubs// rak+ṣa'i g.yang gzhi stag sham gyon// sbrul rgyan dgra sta zhags pa khyer// nag po khyung mgo g.yu 'brug khrid// spra spre spro ba'i shing bya can// la lar gser gyi spu gris 'khyud// sngo skya 'bar ba sprul par ston// mthing nag rdo rje legs pa blon// g.yar dam skongs so 'phrin las sgrubs// sha gos ber nag smyug zhu can// sba mkhar tsan dan beng chen bsgreng*// spyang ki khras bskor dre'u zhon// dmar po dgra lha skyes gcig pu// sa la pad+ma skyes dang dgyes// mthing nag ral brdzes sprul par ston// rdo rje grags ldan kha lo pa// g.yar dam skongs so 'phrin las sgrubs// ha ri la zhon zhal gsum pa// phyag drug mtshon bsnams thod steng zhwa// dar dkar zhing lpags stag chas can// tshub ma khrid pa pe dkar te// a phyi bdud gza' smin dkar yum// nag po lpags gyon sprul par ston// blon po pu tra nag po ste// g.yar dam skongs so 'phrin las sgrubs// 'phrin las mdzad pa'i ru 'dren dang*// dus gsum gdug pa'i lha ma srin// de dag kun kyang mchod lags kyis// dgos pa'i don 'dir myur du sgrubs//

zhes pa yi ge'i phyi mo sh+lau ka dang por byas nas/ chos skyong 'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga 'di yang*/ dpal 'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos/ zan yangs lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po dang*/ nye ba'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o/// / 'jig rten klu dbang gtsug na nor bu'i mchog /bsam pa'i re ba thams cad skong mdzad pa// mtshungs med bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha// chos skyong rje blon 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig /phun tshogs bsod nams stobs las grub pa'i bcud// rgya ja dri bzang mdog mdzes ro brgya pa// mos blos mkha' khyab bdud rtsi'i mtshor dmigs nas// mchod do grub pa brgyad kyi dngos grub stsol// rtsa tshogs dhū tīr dag pa'i bde skyong mar// nā da'i sngags rgyas phung khams skye mched chos// dwangs ma'i khams bzhu zag med bdud rtsir 'bul// mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'i dge legs stsol// sgyu 'phrul snang bas mdzes pa'i stong nyid la// mi 'gyur snying rje'i gang ba chags pa'i ro// zung 'jug ye shes bdud rtsi'i longs spyod kyis// mchod bya mchod byed mnyam pa nyid du mchod// chos skyong chen po'i bkas bskul nas btsun pa pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// / dur khrod bdag mo sgrub par 'dod pas/ hūm̐ kun bzang dga' ba bskyed pa'i yum// khros ma nag mo'i rdzu 'phrul mthu// las kyi ma mor shar ba gang*// mtshan du 'dre mo ngan ne ma// dur khrod kun gyi bdag mo ste// rdo rje'i pho nya sna yon ma// chos 'khor skyong ba'i gzhi ba ste// dge 'dun 'du ba'i dkor gnyer ma// bar chad bzlog pa'i mthu mo che// 'phrin las sgrub pa'i shugs rtsal can// sde brgyad 'khol ba'i dbang phyug ma// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// o a ra li ṭa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dang por rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// dbang bskur dus kyi dam tshig sgron// bar du brgyud pa bzhi ldan gyi// bla mas bka' la btags pa dgongs// tha mar nged cag rnal 'byor pas// mchod bstod bskul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ mahā pad+ma hu ru hu ru kro dha ni hur/

kyai/ mi sha khrag gi dri tshor tshe// rkan rdeb bzod pa'i glags med ma// gsar du bsad pa'i khrag gi mtsho// lbu ba'i 'phreng ba 'chang ba 'bul// don lnga snod drug sha dang rus// tshil bu mdangs bkrag dbugs srog zas// dbang po lnga po brjid pa'i brgyan// pags rlon na bza' rkang gi gling*// yid 'ong dkor nor gser skyems dang*// g.yu skyems ya lad mtshon cha dang*// gzhon pa mdos glud yas btags dang*// dmar chen gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes// oṃ ra li ṭa ma ya dza sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ yab ni 'od zer 'od po che// gza' bdud kun gyi rgyal po ste// dgra bo 'phog 'gyel mod la gsod// yum ni lha sa ba mo lcam// klu mo kun gyi bdag mo yin// nyams pa mdze shu zha bar byed// ming po gnod sbyin bse mdung dmar// bdud nag zo ra ra skyes dang*// gshan pa ra mgo mi hreng dmar// pho rgyud kun gyi sde dpon te// gdug pa 'ching gzer myo 'bog gtong*// lha mo ngan ne klu mo bdud// mched zla lags te ma mo'i dpon// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'gyed// chung ba khyod nyid nyi ma'i mdog /rtsa zhal khro la spyan gsum dmar// steng ma bya nag skyung ka'i mdog /mthong na bred la phrad na 'jigs// gnod na blu ba'i thabs gzhan med// nal bu'i rgyal mtshan me long dang*// res 'ga' ma nges ci yang 'dzin// ral gu zhing chen sgro thul gyon// gar 'ongs me rlung du bar 'tshubs// 'ur 'ur chem chem sa gzhi g.yo// ri bo bsnyil zhing skar mda' ltung*// gnam lcags ser ba ci yang 'bab// ce spyang gtum po ngur sgra 'byin// bya gcan klad la lding zhing 'brang*// lha srin sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed// de ring bskul lo dam tshig can// bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs// do nub rbad do gdug pa can// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor byed kun sgrol//

pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o// hūm̐ mtho ba srid pa'i yas steng gi /rtsub 'gyur tshal du ru mtshon can// dkar po lha yi dbang phyug gi /dmag dpon chen po gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ dma' ba sa 'og rim pa dgu'i// grong khyer mchog na srog bdag dmar// chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje yi// las mkhan chen po gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ bar gyi bdud yul kha rag gling*// gdong dmar yul nas ab bse rgyal// zhang zhung bon gyi skyong ba che// dgra lha'i rgyal po gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ lhag pa mon khams things po yi// bde chen gnas nas btsan rgod brgyad// rig 'dzin bla ma'i bka' nyan mchog /jag pa me len gshegs su gsol//

mchod pa/ hūm̐ bsad pa'i dmar chol lbu gsar can// dgra bo'i snying rtsa nas babs dang*// sna tshogs 'bru yi dza gad ni// gser ga g.yu gas brgyan te 'bul// hūm̐ dgra mgo bregs pa'i 'phreng ba gtibs// sha dri gsar pa'i na bun 'thul// rgyal ba'i ru mtshon snang ba sbar// dpa' ba'i 'brug sgra ldir ba 'bul// hūm̐ yi gar 'ong ba bsgrub pa'i rgyan// sdang ba dgra bo 'joms pa'i chas// mna' 'os 'khyil gyi gnangs chen nor// phyugs kyi 'gro ba kun kyang 'bul// hūm̐ rta dmar glang dmar ra dag gi /sha ni ngar bcas ba ling ta// snying dang nang khrol sna tshogs kyis// rgyal mtsho chen por byas pa 'bul// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ gdug pa khyod kyi gzugs kyi byin// ma rungs jag pa'i tsha ngad kyis// bar chad bgegs kyi phye ma leb// thams cad gzhob kyang med par sreg /hūm̐ gzir ba'i spyan gyis ma non bgegs// khros pa'i zhal gyi mche ba'i rtser// me len dam tshig nyams pa'i srog /'jig rten khams na cang med do// hūm̐ rdo rje'i rmog zhu khrab chen phub// mdung dmar zhags bzung mdo drug chas// zhud can rtar zhon dpa' skyen gdong*// sus kyang tshugs par mi nus so// hūm̐ srin bya khus 'debs 'phar khyi ngar// btsan dmag co sgras khol ba rnams// me ru 'bar zhing rlung du 'tshubs// dgra bo'i srog la dug tu 'gyur// bskul ni/ hūm̐ srid gsum 'joms pa'i jag pa ni// zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba rnams// dgra bo'i srog rtsa len la song*// srog dang dbugs la rngam zas kyis// hūm̐ mi sdug gzugs dgu'i rdzu 'phrul jag /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du sgyur// mi snyan ngag gi dmod pa'i me// len mkhan dgra 'di yin pas sgyur// hūm̐ lha srin dregs pa'i jag dpon khyod// thub pa'i lha 'dre gar yang med// mi bo zas skal yin pa'i phyir// dgra bos me 'dra srog len mdzod// hūm̐ jag dmar ral gu brdabs nas khyod rbad do// dam bskul me dpung sbar nas khyod rbad do// len rtsa'i rtsa ba bshad nas khyod rbad do// dgra bo tshar gcod las 'di myur du sgrubs//

dam can jag pa me len zhes// grub pa'i bka' nyan de mchod pa'i// cho ga hūm̐ sgra bcu drug pa// pad+ma dkar po bdag gis sbyar/// / gdan sa ra lung gi gzhi'i bdag po'i gsol kha bzhugs// dpal ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu gtsang ba'i bshos bu ji ltar dgyes pa bshams nas/ sih+la la sogs pa'i spos bsregs te/ 'di skad gyer par bya'o/// / hūm̐ 'dzam gling byang phyogs gdong dmar can gyi yul// bkra shis g.yang chags dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mdud// grub pa'i mchod sdong dpal ldan ra lung thil// legs par skyong zhing mi mthun las bsrung ba// dpal brjid lhun chags gangs ri'i lhun po nas// dpal gyi dbang phyug kun la dbang bsgyur ba// srid pa'i lha chen gnod sbyin dbang po ni// gang ba bzang po 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon// grub pa'i ri bo spos ngad ldan pa nas// phun tshogs 'byor pa mang pos kun phyug pa// stobs ldan dge bsnyen btsan rgod chen po ni// mi sngon rta sngon 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon// 'jigs shing rngam pa'i lung pa sgo mo nas// dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed ma mthu rtsal can// dregs pa'i mi bsrun yongs kyi rje bo ni// gza' bdud ming sring 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon// gzhan yang gtsug lag khang dang yul 'khor dang*// sa dang ri bo kun la gnas pa yi// lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad// rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir spyon// ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥgazhi'i bdag po ma lus pa 'khor bcas khra phung gis byon par bsam/ bsangs shing ci tshogs pa sbar te/ 'di skad gyer bar bya'o// hūm̐ ha ri tsan dan phung po sprin ltar phub// a kar nag po'i dog pa'i ra bas bskor// sih+la na khī sbyar ba'i ka ba sgreng*// du ru ka yi 'phreng bas brgyan pa'i khang*// lo ma ljang snum rgyas pa'i ljon pa dang*// me tog bsung zhim sdong po ngad bzang ba// rtsa ba dri mchog ldan rnams khor yug tu// bskor bas gtsang ma'i me lces legs sbar ba'i// sngo bsangs dud sprin gzhon nus nam mkha' yang*// khebs par byas shing spos ngad kun khyab pas// bsangs so bsangs so gzhi yi bdag po rnams// sbyin bdag nad dang grib las thar bar mdzod//

de nas dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i rdzas ji snyed 'bul bar bya ste/ thog mar gtsang ma'i chang phud 'bru dang sbyar ba rin po che'i snod kyis gtor zhing 'di skad do// hūm̐ mthong bas yid 'phrog kha dog bzang po ldan// tshor bas skom sel dri ngad zhim po ldan// myangs na lus sems tshim byed dza gad phud// gtsang ma'i 'bru dang sbyar ba 'dis mchod do// mdzes sdug dri bzang yid 'ong lha rdzas su// byin gyis brlabs pa me tog bdug pa'i spos// snang gsal dri chab ro brgya ldan pa'i zas// dkar gsum mngar gsum sgra snyan dkor cha dbyig /'dod dgu'i tshogs rnams gtsang ma la dgyes pa'i// dge bsnyen lha klu sman sogs dgyes par rol// dgra bo'i sna lnga me tog gsur chen spos// snang gsal mar me khrag sna'i yon chab dang*// snying sna'i zhal zas rkang gling drag po'i rdzas// ma tshang med par ting 'dzin gyis sprul par// gdug pa'i sde brgyad thams cad dgyes par rol// gtor ma thams cad swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bzung*/ g.yon mchog sbyin rdeb pa ltar byas la/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta/ a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis gtor rdzas rang rang gi yid dang mthun pas nam mkha' gang bar bsams nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gang ba bzang po/ nor bu bzang po/ btsan rgod dge bsnyen chen po mi sngon rta sngon/ dregs pa can sgo mo'i gza' bdud ming sring la sogs pa gdan sa rin po che ra lung gi chab 'og gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad kyi rigs su gtogs pa la gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul lo// gsol lo// mchod do// bsngo'o// 'dren no// sbyin no// i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyis ngoms shing tshim par

bsams la bstod pa bya ste/ hūm̐ 'dod dgu'i char gyis dbul 'phongs nyer sel zhing*// 'jig rten bkra shis bde legs rgyas byed pa// gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang*// sangs rgyas bstan skyong 'khor bcas bsngags par bgyi// skye 'gro kun gyi mgon skyabs legs byed cing*// chos dang mthun pa'i rkyen rnams dbang med sgrub// rtag tu mi nor dbang du sdud pa yi// btsan rgod chen po 'khor bcas bsngags par bgyi// nyams pa'i srog dbugs skad cig kho nar len// dam can kun gyi bsam pa'i re ba skongs// sde brgyad kun gyi rje bo drag rtsal can// gza' bdud ming sring 'khor bcas bsngags par bgyi// mi sdug gzugs 'chang khro gtum rngam pa'i tshogs// rang rang dpung dang mthu yi rtsal bton nas// dben gnas gnyan po skyong ba'i mi ma yin// lha srin 'jigs byed thams cad bsngags par bgyi// de ltar bstod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba// slob dpon chen po pad+ma kā ra dang*// grub pa'i gtsug rgyan chos rje khu dbon zhabs// slob mar bcas pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// gdan sa chen po dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// chos ldan sgrub pa po yi bsam don sgrub// yul 'khor bkra shis 'byor pas gang bar gyis// mi mthun gnod cing 'tshe ba tshar chod la// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar mdzod// bskul bar 'dod na gtor ma kho rang so sor mos shing thim par bsam la 'di skad do// hūm̐ bstan pa bsrung ba lha srin drag po'i dpung*// kha cig mdog nag go mtshon nag po can// lhun po pang du bteg nas dgra la 'phen// la la khrag gi phung po ltar dmar bas// nyams pa'i mgo bcad khrag 'thung nang khrol 'jib// 'ga' zhig dus mtha'i sprin bzhin cher gnag pa// gnam lcags me dang rdo rje ser ba 'bebs// ljang dang ser ba'i gzugs ldan 'jigs byed dga'// rkang pa sa la brdab pas dbang chen yang*// rdul du 'thag cing nyams pa zhe la gnon// sman btsun mdzes ma'i gzugs kyis blo 'khrid cing*// khram shing 'debs dang sho rde dkar nag spung*// gso sgras gnam sa 'dar zhing khol byed dmag

/mang po'i sde dpon gang bzang nor bu bzang*// mi sngon gza' bdud seng ge stag dang rta// phag rgod zhon nas 'dzam gling myul ba rnams// gson cig sdang ba'i dgra bo che ge mos// bstan pa bshig cing bla ma'i sku la bsdo// bdag gi dam pa'i chos la bar chad byas// dkon mchog dbu 'phangs smod 'di khyed rnams kyis// brang zhol phrol la srog brngubs zhal du thob// yul mkhar khyim bshig nor rdzas brlags pa dang*// bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod cig dam can tshogs// zhes bskul nas gtor ma 'phangs pas dgra bo rmeg med bcom par bsam mo// dge slong pad+ma dkar pos spos skya'i yang dben du sbyar ba'o/// / dud sol ma'i gsol bsdus/ a yig rnam 'gyur khang brtsegs mdzes pa'i mkha'// ha har rgod dbus thod mkhar brtsigs pa'i klong*// sa gsum gom res 'gengs pa'i bong bu'i steng*// sha za chen mo dud sol dgra bgegs rnams// la 'ur ral gris bsad khrag bhañdzar 'thungs// rwa ltar shak+ti gtod cing rtse gsum 'phyar// ya mtshan bcas su 'dod dbang kun gyis bcug /'a 'ur gsod 'chings 'gugs byed rigs bzhi ma// za byed phra men brgyad dang sgo ma bzhi// zhwa ltar klad lding rol 'dur shul 'brang rnams// wa ler dran pa'i dad dang dam tshig gis// dzaḥzhes ga na bzhugs kyang spyan 'dren no// tsha ba'i ngad kyis dgra bo phye ma leb// tsa ra mdzad du 'dir gshegs 'khor bcas rnams// ma cig dbang bskur dam sbyin sbran pa bdag /ba ni 'dod 'jor bsngags pa bzhin gyis skyongs// pha mtha' med pa'i nam mkha' srid gsum gyi// pa ti 'byor pa'i sprin gyis bkab pa dang*// na rag dmyal srungs mgu ba'i rak+ta dang*// da dgra dngos byed bsad pa'i snying khrag rba// tha mar sbyangs rtogs 'bar bzhu'i ba liṃ ta// ta na bsgral dang ga na sbyor ba'i chas// nya rgyas zla ltar 'jig rten gang bas mchod// ja ltar ma lus dga' ba khyod kyi gzugs// cha shas re rer 'gyur ba rten bzhin du/

ca re chos nyid klong las mi 'da' ba// nga med don rtogs spyod yul lags zhes bstod// ga na'ang khyod bsgom snying po bzlas pa dang*// kha tsam min par dam rdzas kyis bskangs zhing*// ka dag dbyings su sdig kun mthol bshags so// gnyis su med las gnyis su bye nas su// mthu rtsal chen pos dgra bgegs bdud kyi sde// re re tsam min ma lus skad cig la// sod cig thul cig bcom ldan dud sol ma// g.yu sgron ma'i/ kyai/ khrag 'thung chen po'i grong khyer tsa ri tra'i// tsit+ti'i dbyibs 'chang rdo ba'i phug nang nas// zhing skyong ma mo'i gtso mo g.yu sgron ma// 'khor bcas dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// kyai/ dam tshig gtsang ma'i rgyu rkyen las grub pa'i// sman phud rgya ja skol dang ba liṃ rnams// kha dog dri bzang ro brgya ldan pa'i bcud// 'chi med bdud rtsir bzhu bas dgyes par 'tshal// kyai/ 'jigs byed chen mo'i gzugs 'chang wā rā hī// bka' nyan chen mo zhi tshe lha mo'i gzugs// bod khams bstan ma kun gyi rje mo mdzad// zhing skyong lhan cig skyes ma gsang ba'i mtshan// lhag par khros pa mgo dgu srin mo'i byin// lha srin sde brgyad dbus kyi gtso mo ste// za byed mkha' 'gro zhes pa gsang ba'i mtshan// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal bdag cag gi /yid kyi re ba thams cad grub par mdzod// cig car dmar po'i/ kyai/ lho phyogs tsa ri tra dang sa 'og dgu'i// thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer chen po nas// las kyis gshin rje 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gyis// dam can chos kyi rgyal po gshegs su gsol// kyai/ bsad pa'i dmar chol dza gad phud kyi skom// sha rus snying gi gtor ma chen po gang*// dgra bgegs bla tshe srog dbugs kha rje dang*// dbang thang rlung rtar bcas pa zas su 'bul// kyai/ 'jig rten lho yi phyogs skyong ba// sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad// srid pa'i dge sdig shan thang 'byed// chos kyi rje nas da lta'i bar// bstan pa bsrung ba'i gtso bor bkur/

rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha che// do nub bdag gis bstod lags kyis// bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol// hrīḥ rdo rje btsun mo'i snying rje'i pad+ma'i sbubs// brdol der bcu drug lang tsho'i g.yu sgron ma// mdzes sdug yid ris rdzogs pas mtshar de mig /kun la rngam brjid 'os pa'i bdud rtsir 'khrungs// de tshe chags bral 'khor lo'i mgon po yang*// de yi phyogs lhung nges nas tsa ri tra'i// ḍā ki? ma rnams gtsug gi nor bu'i chus// zhabs mthil bkru la hab bshar byed pa de'i// mthing sngon skra yi zur phud ri bo'i rtser// 'dzegs pa nor bu'i byin la nyi ma yis// shar gyi thor cog 'char ka'i 'od zer gyis// pa tras bcings pa stong gi 'ol phyir min// tshangs skud rtse phran rin chen lnga'i rang bzhin// snyan gong ut+pal dar dpyangs dang bcas bzo// 'dren byed rnams 'ching bsod nams las rang gar// grub pas bi shwa'i 'du byed byis pa'i rtsal// rab dkar bzhin gyi shangs rgyud ri bo'i 'dab// sems 'chings mig zur bskyod pa'i bsir bu des// smin ma'i 'khri shing gar gyis rol ba dang*// reg byas chags ldan gdong la rgya skyegs byugs// slar yang mkhur tshos dkar dmar mdangs bkrag pos// khor yug snang bas mdzes pa brgya byin gzhur// bgyis la 'gran 'dod mchu yi pad+ma'i 'dzum// so yi ge sar bye des mun pa'ang bcom// 'gram par 'od kyi rba rlabs cher spro ba'i// rna cha de gnyis nyi zlar rab 'khrul nas// go la rgyu skar phra tshoms can de yang*// mgul gyi phyogs der lhun po la bzhin 'khor/ lha rdzas dar dkar yug de'i lhub gon dang*// lhan cig g.yu yi do shal 'dzin pa gang*// sprin gyi gos can sngo bsangs khyod la sems// shor ba'i gyu yin srid pa'i khong pa mno// sked pa'i 'khri zhing ha cang phra bas na// nu 'bur 'bras rgyas g.yur za mi theg ces// 'dzam bu'i gser sked dra ba can 'dar nas// smad du za 'og ding phon 'ja' tshon bran// gdu bu'i sil snyan 'khrol ba 'jam pa'i phyag

/grags pa'i rnga bo dal bur bskul ba des// dri za'i dga' ma rnams la rgyud mangs kyi// snyan cha shor bar gyur snyam sems las skyes// brla rgyas mkhrang bar phyed kyi skyil mo krung*// bcas nas 'gying ba'i bag de me na ka /rtsed 'jos dran bslang 'dod pa spyad pa'i ched// 'dug bsam lha yi dbang po 'khyud la khad// gnas gsum pad+mo'i tshal gyi ngang mo'i gtso// lhan cig skyes mar grags pa'i yon tan gyi// dar zab snyan tshig me tog gis brgyan nas// bstod pa'i lda ldir byas lhag spyan gzigs ci// kun rtog rkang 'thung yal 'dab ma lus pa/ so so rang rig zhugs su zhen pa'i rtags/ stong nyid mkha' la 'khyud pa'i dud pa'i sprin// gnyis snang sangs 'di sgyu 'phrul bdug pa'i spos// yon po'i lam bkag gtum mos sbar ba las// bsil ba'i 'od dkar bye ba 'dzag pa'i gzi// 'pho med mkha' la bcug pa'i snang byed rdzu// snyigs ma'i khams rnams 'khrud pa'i chab tu'ang sprul// srid gsum sgyu ma tsam gyi kha zas la// mgron gnyer nā da'i rol mos bskul ba'i rjes// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dod yon la// skad rnams kun gyis rol pa'i brda yang sprad// dung can g.yung mo sbyar ba'i bde skyong du// nyi zla'i bdud rtsi ye shes sgra gcan gyis// bzung nas dhū tī'i 'dab ma'i rtser spel ba'i// tshogs 'di ma mo dgyes pa'i dpyid cis min// rtsa 'khor lto 'phye'i bdag po bgrang yas kyi// gdengs kas drangs pa 'od lnga nor bu'i dpyas// gtsug tor bang mdzod gang mthus dngos nor rnams// chos nyid rang khyim bsdu 'di khyod kyi khang*// rtse gcig rwa cos rtog dgra'i snying phug cing*// 'khrul pas nags min chos kyi dbyings gang du// dpa' bar 'jug la rdo rje'i shugs ldan pa'i// sprin dum chad 'dra ting 'dzin g.yag rgod sde// zung 'jug lus grims gzhan don rngog ma ni// sprugs kyang mi g.yo gnam mkha'i gdangs gang la// bsnyengs pa'i rdul med cang shes mchog gi khyu// myang 'das nor 'dzin gzhi la 'khyams rnams dang*// phung khams skye mched ci dga'i gtor mang gi

/rnam par bsgyur yang mkha' khyab mkha' yi ro// ngo bo mi gtong gcig tu bsdoms byas pa'i// bdud rtsi'i nying khus thugs dam skong gyur cig /bskangs nas 'khor bar bslu ba'i bag la zha// dug gsum g.yul ngor bcas las rgyal ba'i sar// tshe 'dis pho nya lta bur bgrod pa'i rten// gzhan na ma mchis khyod nyid kho nar rag/

bcom ldan 'das ma lhan cig skyes ma'i bskang ba pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// / hūm̐ 'jigs byed che rnams lhag par khros pa'i shugs// srid gsum srog gi zas can gshin rje yi// pho nya'i gtsug der bka' btags mi mgo'i 'phreng*// 'ching bar sprul pa cig car dmar po'i sku// nyi ma 'char ka'i lang tshor zhugs pa'i tshe// rgya mtsho ma lus 'thung ba rta gdong me// chags te 'khril bas phas kyi byad ma'i mthu// phye ma leb bzhin gzhob kyang med par sreg /dkar zhing dbyibs zlum mtho ba'i gangs can ri// yungs 'bru lta bur bsgyur ba'i mche ba bzhis// bsnun pa'i khrag gis sbangs ba'i sma ra yi// tshom bu de yang dregs pa rnams la ngom// spyan gnyis bskyod pas nyi ma zla ba'i byin// ma lus phrogs nas smin ma 'khyog pa'i phug /ngal bso rten der gser gyi ri bo rnams// pa tra'i zol gyis steng nas 'gebs par rtsom// khro gnyer gyis bcings shangs kyi bu ga nas// lhun po thal bar 'thor ba'i rlung spros te// rgol ba'i tshogs rnams shing gi lo ma bzhin// rgya mtsho'i pha rol bskrad kyang bsnyengs ma mchis// bdud dang dgra bo bsgral ba'i rgyu ma'i 'phreng*// khrag gis bkang te ral par byas nas su// sprugs pa'i khrod der gdug pa'i sbrul mang gi /kha rlangs dud las phyogs bcur mun pa sbyin// ta hun za 'og ber gyis bsgribs byas kyang*// dbyig gi rna shal mgul rgyan gdu bu'i gzi// blta bar mi bzod lhag par lto 'gro'i rgyan// sgra gcan 'dud par byas pa lta bus 'jigs/ phyag gnyis lcags gzhu bdungs nas mi bzad mda'// 'phangs tshe gnam lcags bye ba babs so zhes// nyams pa yul 'khor brlag pa'i cho nges sgra// 'bum phrag 'brug sgra cig car ldir zhing grags// rmig pa'i 'degs 'jog re la gling bzhi'i mtha'// gnon pa'i chu glang dmar po la bcibs nas// srid gsum myul ba'i mgyogs pa'i khyad par la// dus mtha'i rlung shugs de yang dag pa ster// rno bas dgung dbral ru dar gyis bkab nas// mtshon chas drubs pa'i gnam sa'i tshogs bu pa// gshin rje gsham pa stong dang drug brgya sogs// sde brgyad 'khor tshogs bstod pas thugs dam bskang*// 'bru yi chang gi chu klung stong 'bab cing*// sbyar ba'i ro yi gter gyur dri mdangs kyi// rba klong ci yang 'khrug pa'i gser gyi skyems// rgya mtsho chen po'i phud kyis thugs dam bskang*// dag byed bsangs kyi dud sprin 'thibs pa'i rum// le brgan dar 'phyar bskyod pa'i glog 'gyur zhing*// rnga sil dung dbyangs dbyar skyes sgra ldan pa'i// mchod bstod mi zad char gyis thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs dar dpyangs mda' rnon lhab lhub kyi// lda ldir byas pa nam mkha'i dur khrod rnams// dbang po'i mtshon cha bsad ba'i ro tshogs kyis// gang ba byas pa lta bus thugs dam bskang*// bsad pa'i khrag gis gsher ba'i dgra bo'i snying*// don dang nang khrol sbreng ba gsar pa'i drir// las byed pho nya'i mkha' lding ma lus pa// rngam rngam thib thib bgyid pas thugs dam bskang*// ma rungs srin po'i thod pa ya tshal nang*// bsad pa'i khrag la sbrus pa'i bshos bu 'di// lha chen bsgral ba'i snying dang dri ro nus// mtshungs par byin gyis brlabs pas thugs dam bskang*// sbyangs rtogs 'bar bas sgron ma lnga yi gnam// zhu bar dogs nas ye shes zla nyi yis// nus pa'i bdud rtsi de la bstim byas pa'i// tshogs kyi mchod pa chen pos thugs dam bskang*// rwa dang rmig pa sngo bsangs mig dmar zhing*// kham pa'i spu stug ri ltar brjid pa'i g.yag

/glang dmar smyon pa sprin gyi shugs ldan rta// stobs kyi ngar skad 'byin pas thugs dam bskang*// mi yi tshil zhag gis bgos mda' dang mdung*// rno ba'i ral gri dgra sta tho ba dang*// be con 'khor lo la sogs 'chi bdag gi /mche ba sgrigs pa 'dra bas thugs dam bskang*// rgod thul dar tshon gyis spud rin chen rmog /sra mkhregs nor bu'i khrab dang rnga ma yis// dbang po'i gzhu ris 'drar bgyis phub chen dang*// pir phub ya lad kun gyis thugs dam bskang*// mthun pa'i dam tshig gtsang zhing chad bzhin du// bsgrubs pa'i yus ldan tshul du bsnyen pa la// mi g.yel nyams chag med pa'i lhag bsam gyis// ral pa tshar dgu khyod thugs skongs gyur cig /lus srog 'ben du btsugs nas bdag cag la// bsdo ba'i dgra bo'i srog dbugs bzhes mdzod la// yul mkhar khyim yang ming tsam lhag ma ru// bzhag pa'i 'phrin las 'tshal lo ma g.yel cig/ cig car dmar po'i bskang ba pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// / hūm̐ smug nag bh+yo las rdo rje rab brtan ma// khro gtum sgeg la 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar// dmar chen thod par 'thung zhing ne'u le bsnams// skad cig dre'u zhon nas 'dzam gling myul// klu dar bdud kyi bka' nyan ma mo'i tshogs// mthun pa'i rdzas la spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ las thod pa 'bar ba stong gsum tsam// āḥlas dgra bo'i don lnga snod dang khrag /hūm̐ las 'chi med bdud rtsi lngar sbyangs pa// lha mo 'khor bcas zhal du kha raṃ kha'i// khyod thugs dgyes pa skyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin// re re'ang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga tshang ba// rab 'byams nam mkha' khyab par blos sprul nas// thugs dam gnyan po bskang ngo dam can la// srid pa gsum na dbang mo che// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu mo che// bstan pa bsrung ba'i rtsal mo che// bsam pa sgrub pa'i stobs mo che// bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po yi// gnod pa'i rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol//

gad ser gyi sgrub pa ba rnams kyi kha ton du sbyar ba'o/// / dge bsnyen jo dmag mchod pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ dpal 'brug pa yab sras la phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo dmag dpon nam rong lha rgyal mtshan mchod par 'dod pas/ dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas dmar gyi gtor ma/ mkho dgu'i spyan gzigs ji snyed pa bkram ste/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer bar bya'o// hūm̐ bdud dang srin po gnod sbyin dang*// 'jigs byed ma mo la sogs pa// ma rungs sde brgyad 'du ba'i gling*// lcags mkhar rtse dgu'i pho brang nas// 'jigs su rung ba'i dregs pa can// sangs rgyas bstan bsrung khyed 'bod do// tshur gshegs bka' yi pho nya che// jo bo dmag dpon 'dir spyon cig /sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐ phyogs rnams bsung zhim ngad pas rnam 'gengs pa'i// spos dang 'khan shug shing sna ji snyed pa'i// dung sprin yid 'ong mkha' la 'khrigs pa 'dis// dmag dpon chen po 'khor dang bcas pa bsangs// mthong tshad sems 'chor tshor tshad yid sim zhing*// myangs tshad ngoms pa med pa'i dga' ston mchog /lha yi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs pa'i// gser skyems dza gad phud kyi mchod pa 'bul// yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rta nag rting dkar dang*// rngam pa'i g.yag rog lug nag spyi dkar dang*// khyi nag dom bu snying dkar la sogs pa// gnam la 'phur dang sa la 'dzul dgus mchod// rin thang can gyi rin chen ri bor spungs// dpa' brjid rno ba'i go mtshon mdun du bdar// dar zab yid 'ong sprin bzhin mkha' la 'khrigs// dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad khyod la 'bul// bsad sha don snying nang khrol ji snyed dang*// mchod rdzas mi rkang gling bu'i sgra snyan dang*// gsum gyi dri dang khrag gi rgya mtsho dang*// dmar chen gtor mas mchod do las 'di sgrub// gtor ma sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis bsngos la/ lha ma srin dregs pa'i sde dpon/

mthu dang rtsal gyi mnga' bdag dgra dang bgegs kyi gshed ma/ jo bo dmag dpon 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// gsol lo// mchod do// dgyes rab kyi mchog mnyes rab kyi phul du phyin par gyur cig de nas bstod par bya ste/ hūm̐ mi bzad glog gi 'od kyis rab brjid pa'i/ char sprin nag po'i mdog mtshungs gdangs ba'i zhal// gangs ri lta bu'i mtshe gtsigs ljags 'dril zhing*// nyin byed 'od stong 'khrugs 'dra khros pa'i spyan// du ba'i klong ltar dbu skra gyen du 'khyil// snyan dang phyag zhabs sbrul gyi 'phreng bas mdzes// rdo rje srin po khros pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa'i// phyag g.yas mdung dmar ba dan mkha' la 'phyar// g.yon pa dmar gyi gtor ma thugs kar bzung*// dar nag ber chen brtsegs ma sku la gsol// khrag 'dzag mi mgo'i do shal mgul du bcangs// stag ral g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon na btags// rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta nag rting dkar bcibs// stong gsum skad cig re res myul mdzad khyod// yid 'ong lha dmag 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed// ma rungs bdud nag 'bum sde bran du 'khol// khrag 'thung ma mo 'bum dang rtag par rtse// mi bsrun gshan pa bye ba las la 'gyed// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen khyod// 'khor dang bcas pa bcol ba'i las 'di sgrub// 'phrin las kyi bya ba ji ltar bsgrub dgos pa byung na bskul 'di bya'o// dang por slob dpon gnyan gyi bka'// bar du chos mdzad dam pa'i gsung*// tha mar rnal 'byor bdag gi tshig /ji srid sgrub par ma chad dam// da lta rnal 'byor brjed bskul gyis// lha srin dregs pa'i dpung skyod la// gnam lcags thog dang ser ba phob// yul 'khor lo tog rlag par gyis// gdug pa'i dgra bo 'di zhes pa'i// bla tshe srog dbugs zhal du thob// sha khrag sde brgyad yongs la khye// rbad pa'i dus 'dir mthu ma chung*// mngags pa'i dus 'dir las ma 'gyangs// bsgo ba'i dus 'dir bka' ma bcag

/zhag dang za ma'i long med pas// da lta nyid du rtags phyung zhig/ ces bcol bas gang bcol sgrub par nges so// kho bo'i dge bsnyen dam tshigs ldan pa de'i// mchod sprin nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di na yod// bka' 'bangs rnams la las byed dgos srid na// rims nas mchod dang dgos 'dod 'grub nges yin// pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// / rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// kyai/ mdun du rin chen skyed mos tshal// nor bu'i me tog mdangs bkra bar// g.yu yi bung ba lding zhing 'bab// tsan dan spos kyi nags gseb na// mdzes pa'i bya tshogs skad snyan bsgyur// bdud rtsi chu yi klung ngogs na// yid 'ong ri dwags bag phebs rtse// pad+mos khyab pa dbab pa'i mtshor// chu bya gzhon nu mgrin rnga 'khrol/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i 'gram// mthon ka'i ne'u gsing yid 'ong la// phra mdzes g.yu yi gur khang phub// gser khri zla shel 'bol gdan dang*// lha rdzas yol ba bla re bres// de na srid pa'i sman chen mo// rdo rje kun bzang kun grags ma// ya ma skyong dang bgegs kyi gtso// spyan gcig klu mo dpal gyi yum// grags mo rgyal dang bod khams skyong*// sman gcig zu le g.yar mo bsil/ sgeg cing 'gying bag ldan par bzhugs// ding phon ral gu lhab lhub gyon// mdzes pa'i rgyan cha sil sil btags// 'bum phrag 'khor gyis mdun du bdar// kyai/ phyi ltar brtan ma bcu gnyis te// gnam gyi mo btsun sman mo 'phrul// gnas ni bod khams kha ba'i yul// mu stegs bzlog cing dam chos skyong*// nang ltar 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rdzu// spyan ras gzigs kyi 'bangs mo mdzad// 'dug pa'i pho brang g.yu lo bkod// sems can 'dul zhing rgyal ba mchod// gsang bar de nyid mkha' 'gro ma// rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung*// he ru ka dang gnyis med 'khyud// gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs// de ring khyed rnams spyan 'dren pa'i// tshig snyan dbyangs rta kyu ru ru// mos shing gus pas cher gdungs pa'i// mchi ma'i rgyun ni sha ra ra// dgyes pa skyed pa'i dam tshig tu// rnga sil gling bu kyu ru ru// grib sel dri bzang mi dman pa'i// spos dkar dud pa thu lu lu// dar zab rnam pa lnga dbyangs pa'i// sgro ldan g.yab mo'i ling se lings// yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// kyai/

po ṭa la yi pho brang du// 'jig rten mgon pos dbang bskur nas// nag po'i phyogs kyi gshed mar bskos// dkar po'i phyogs kyi rje mor bsngags// de nas rdo rje thod 'phreng gis// bal yul yang le shod sogs su// gnad la gzir nas bod khams kyi// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnyer kha gtad// sgra bsgyur mar pa yab sras kyis// sgrub pa po yi lha ru bskos// bka' rgyud bstan pa spel bar mngags// da lta bskul gyis dam ma 'da'// kyai/ nas dang 'bras dang rgun chang gi /gser skyems rba rlabs mkha' la snyog /yar mo klung gi lha min khrag /g.yu skyems lags te 'tsho bzhin 'khyil// pad+ma ut+pal ku mu ta'i// me tog gzhal med khang du chags// spos dkar shing sna cher tshogs kyis// dud pa gdugs dang bla rer bres// snang gsal mar me'i 'od dmar gyi// yol bas phyogs rnams mdzes par sbrel// dri bzang chab kyi ba dan ni// bar snang yid 'ong khyab par bkram// dpag bsam shing las 'ongs gyur pa'i// lha rdzas bza' btung mchod par bshams// 'chi med rol mo yan lag 'bum// rnga sil gling bu dbyangs kyis bsgrag /pañtsa li ka'i gos sogs dang*// rin chen 'dod dgu'i char rnams kyis// bcom ldan ma kun mchod lags kyis// bdag gi bsam pa'i re ba sgrubs// gtor ma swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ las gtor snod āḥlas 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin/ hūm̐ gis zag pa med pa'i ye shes su dmigs te/ ma ma/ kha kha/ le le/ ta ta/ te te/ e a/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs kyis bsngos/ kyai/ dpal mo bcu drug lang tsho can// shin tu zhi ba chu shel mdog /mtshar sdug ldan te bris pa 'dra// rin chen dpag bsam rgyan gos 'chang*// phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel ma// 'khor yang yid 'ong lha mo lags// thugs dam bskangs so bsam don sgrubs// rgyas pa'i las mdzad gser gyi 'od// dpa' zhing sgeg pa gter gyi bdag

/gnod sbyin sras mo brjid pa'i byin// ut+pal 'phreng ba gos ser mnabs// yid bzhin nor bu lag na khyer// tshe dang bsod nams dpal skyed ma// bran g.yog nor sbyin bu mo'i sde// thugs dam bskangs so bsam don sgrubs// dgug cing dbang gi las mdzad tshe// rin chen byi ru'i mdog tu ston// zhi ma khro la spyan gsum mnga'// 'gro la rab chags sgeg mo'i 'gying*// 'gugs byed lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams// khams gsum srid pa'i yid bsgul ma// 'bangs kyang zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// thugs dam bskangs so bsam don sgrub// mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzad tshe// mthing nag srin mo khros pa'i gzi// rdo rje'i mche ba rnon po gtsigs// mi bzad rngam pa'i shugs glu len// ral pa kham nag sa la 'drud// nu ma smug nag phrag par bkal// phyag sor bsgrad nas mgyogs pa'i bang*// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du rgyug /bla tshe srog dbugs zhal du 'gam// sha rgyus rus pa chem chem za// khrag rgyun dmar po'i rba la 'jib// bsad dbye bskrad pa'i mthu rtsal ma// bka' sdod sde dpon sum cus mdzad// thugs dam bskangs so bsam don sgrubs//

brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gsol kha 'di yang dpal gyi zan yang du dpal 'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// / hūm̐ drag po e yi gzhal med khang*// gru gsum mun pa chen po'i dkyil// mi bzad mtshon cha 'bar ba'i klong*// sregs pa'i me dud 'khrugs pa'i nang*// dpal mgon bskal bzang sangs rgyas kyis// bstan pa ris med bsrung mdzad pa// bya rog ming can khro bo'i rgyal// rdo rje 'jigs byed nag po che// yum chen sras dang bka' sdod dang*// las mdzad sde brgyad dregs pa'i sde// phyogs bcu 'jig rten skyong ba kun// snying rjes khros shing gtum pa'i shugs// rang gi sha la za ba tsam// mi bzad drag shul 'chang ba'i lus// mthong ba'i mod la khrag skyug pa// sna tshogs bzhin dang skad kyi byin// dred sdigs sdangs pa kun phung ba// rtul phod las la rngam rgod la// stong gsum myul zhing gling bzhi 'jig /srid pa gsum po'i dbang po kun// rang sder bcas pa bran du khol// sus kyang mi thub rdo rjer mtshungs// stobs kyis nga rgyal dregs pa rnams// thams cad bdag la snyan gson cig /sngon byon rgyal ba thams cad la// bstan pa bsrung ba'i chad mdzad do// rnal 'byor skyong bar dam bcas so// thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab// do nub sdang ba'i dgra gsod cig /do nub gnod pa'i bgegs choms shig /sdig can dgra bo 'di zhes pa// byams pa'i gnyen gyis rgyang du brims/ nyam thag ngal ba kun byung ba// de dus skyob mkhan bdag min su// bden pa khyad bsad bdag la 'tshe/ gnod pa'i dug sbal thams cad 'gyed// 'di la mngon spyod mi mdzad na// dam can srungs mas ci zhig bya// bsten bsten mchod mchod don re chung*// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor yi yang chad// bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// mthu rtsal 'byin pa'i dmag dpung 'chos// gshegs shig dgra bo gnas pa'i sar// yul mkhar khyim bshig pho brgyud chod// mo brgyud mngal sgo skem par gyis// dgra bo 'khor bcas thams cad la// ngu 'bod dmyal ba ma lus sbyin// 'di yi chos kyi dam tshig ral// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gnod// chos gzhi phrogs shing dkor la za// dam pa'i gtsug lag khang 'jig rtsom// sems can yongs kyi bde skyid 'phrog

/nag po'i las la hab bshar byed// bzhag kyang mi tshe bdud las spyod// dge ba su spyod sun 'byin pa// 'di 'dra bsgral ba'i 'os lags so// rnam shes gshin rje'i 'dun sar bor// sha rus snying la rngam zas kyis// khrag gsar rba klong zhal du 'jibs/ lo dang zla bar bzhag mi 'tshal// zhag dang za ma nyid du sgrol// bskul ba'i dus su mthu ma chung*// rbad pa'i tshe na rtsal ma zhan// bcol ba'i las g.yel ma mdzad dang*// myur du gsod cig thul cig ya// cig car dmar po'i/ gtum po gshin rje'i sde dpon khyod// khros pa'i me chen da spor la// dam nyams 'khor bcas bsod nams kyi// bud shing thams cad med par mdzod// ral pa gsigs pa'i khrod de yi// sbrul gyi kha rlangs dug gi mthus// brgyal zhing 'bog pas rang byas rnams// rang la bskor ba'i 'phrin las ran// shangs kyi dus mtha'i rlung gi shugs// spos nas dmag sde nang dbye zhing*// gtor nas gzhan nas skrod par mdzod// lcags kyi gnam ru bdungs pa yis// 'brug sgra bsgrags nas gnam lcags mdas// 'khor bcas bsad pa'i sha khrag gi /dmar dris lung pa gang bar mdzod// glang dmar smyon pa'i rmig pa yis// khang khyim brdzis la rno ba'i rwas// sa zhing rol sul lta bur gyis// rta gdong me lce ltar rngam pa'i// gshin rje'i gshan pa stong drug brgya// brjid pa'i go mtshon can rnams kyi// sgar chen dgra bo'i yul du phob// ma mo'i nang sprin de ru gtibs// bdud sde'i khram kha de la thob// btsan gyi sho rde de ru rtses// klu yi nad kyis de dag gzung*// rgyal po'i smyo 'bog de la sbyor// gza' yi phog 'gyel de la ran// srin po'i rngam zas dus la bab// bskul lo dam tshig can khyod bskul// rbad do dmigs pa'i sa der rbad// bcol lo dgra bo 'joms pa bcol// brdzangs so lo zla long med song*// kong btsun de mo'i bstod pa/

sman btsun mo rdo rje de mo'i mtshan// ljongs kha ba can pa'i yul bdag mo// shar kong po'i yul gyi lha srungs che// bka' bstan pa spyi yi bya ra ba// khyed dgyes pa'i dong khyim zla ba la// mkhur dkar la dmar ba'i rtags bris nas// zhal 'dzum pa'i 'od brgya bkye ba 'di// mig blta ba'i bzhin la mtshar shos yin// sku sha bdo khrag rgyas skem sbeg ran// khrom lha mi dga' ba'i rgyan gyis klubs// gdan 'bol ba'i zab la 'gying bcas pa// dpal nor rgyun ma yi gzi byin dpe// zil chen po khyod mdun mi 'dar gang*// ci bsgo ba mi byed lha srin gar// las mdzad pa skyes bu'i grogs min ci// mthu mtshungs pa med pas 'gron rogs su// khong ma rungs pa la rdo rje'i sprin// las dbye dgug bcing ba glog brgya'i mthar// don mngon spyod thog gi char 'bebs pas// ri ma la ya rtse'i dpal 'phrogs so// khyod dgyes dgu 'byor pa'i skyed tshal 'dir// ro brgya ldan rgya ja'i skyems kyis mchod// dpa' dza gad chang dang dmar chol bcas// zas zhim pa'i ba ling mgron du stabs// thugs dgyes pa'i mdangs dang ldan gyur pas// spyir bod yul khyad par kong po'i ljongs// lo legs shing skya rgyal dus 'khrugs zhi// chos dkar po spyod pas khengs par mdzod// mi bdag gi 'dod pa'i smreng gsol ba// 'di chos dang ldan pas sgrub par zhu// dus de ring mchod pa'i rgyu sbyor la// dpal phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las 'tshal/// / sgo srungs sgo bdud nag po'i gsol kha hūm̐ yig bcu gnyis ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// chos kyi rje gtsang pa rgya ras la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ rdo rje lhun po'i zom chen por// gza' rgod nag po'i mtshan yang 'dzin// phyag brnyan lha min tshogs chen pos// bskor nas 'dir gshegs ki kang khyod// hūm̐ lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug na// 'chi bdud nag po'i mtshan yang 'dzin// bka' nyan dmyal srung gtum po'i sdes// bskor nas 'dir gshegs las gshin khyod// hūm̐

sprul pa'i zhing gi lho phyogs su// sgo bdud nag po'i mtshan yang 'dzin// las mdzad sde brgyad gshan pa'i tshogs// bskor nas 'dir gshegs gnas srungs khyod// spyan 'dren no// hūm̐ dpa' bo'i chang phud rgya mtshor bskyil// dmar chem khrag sna'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// mthun rdzas bshos bu'i ri dbang rtser// dkar dmar zla nyis mdzes pa 'bul// hūm̐ dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di zhes pa'i// srog dang dbugs dang bla dang tshe// sha khrag rus pa'i ba liṃ ta// dmar gyi ngad dri chil bas mchod// hūm̐ nag po dar la bdud kyi mkhar// dgyes dgu yas dang thags la bsgrubs// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod ngo mar// byin gyis brlabs pas thugs dam bskang*// mchod pa'o// hūm̐ mthong ba'i dug rlangs sprin nag gis// mun par 'thibs gzugs lta byed glog /stong phrag g.yo las khrag ral char// ci yang 'bebs la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ za bar byed pa'i kha bo che// mtshon cha'i ngar kun dril ba'i sos// dgra srog gtubs pa'i rak+ta'i rgyun// ma pham 'gram par 'dzag la bstod// hūm̐ rgyal ba'i dam tshig chang 'thungs pa// myos pa'i gad rgyangs mi bzad pa'i// rnam par rol pa brgya phrag gis// ma rungs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod pa'o// hūm̐ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// grub thob rnams la dam bcas pa// da lta rnal 'byor nga bskul gyis/ nag po 'dzum med las la bh+yo// hūm̐ hūm̐ drag shul chen po'i shugs// phaṭ phaṭ dgra bo'i mgo bkas nas// ha ha ga sha cher sgrogs pa'i// hi hi ngo mtshar myur du ston// hūm̐ 'ur 'ur chem chem dmag gi dpung*// hab hab rngam rngam dgra yul rnams// cham cham chom chom zos nas 'dir// dung dung sham sham gtang rag long*// bskul lo// zhes dbon rin po ches bka' phebs nas gnas srungs sgo bdud nag po'i gsol kha hūm̐ yig bcu gnyis ma 'di yang*/ gnyal yangs pa can gyi rgyal po'i khab tu pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /rdo rje legs pa'i gsol kha bzhugs so//

spyan 'dren ni/ kyai/ dbang phyug chen po'i zhing khams nas// rdo rje 'chang dbang sras kyi gtso// skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs// do nub bdag gi gnas 'dir byon// 'jig rten las kyi snang ba nas// gnam the dgra lha'i rgyal po ste// bdud rje mgar ba nag po khyod// dam can chen po gnas 'dir byon// mchod pa ni/ kyai/ dam tshig gtsang zhing yid 'ong ba'i// dza gad phud kyi gser skyems dang*// mthun pa'i mchod pa bzhon pa'i ra// brjid chags rten rdzas thams cad 'bul// lhag par ma rungs dgra bsgral ba'i// dmar chol sha gsar nang khrol dang*// glo snying 'bru nag ba ling ta// 'jig rten khams kun bkang ste 'bul// bstod pa ni/ kyai/ zhi ba dkar po'i chos skyong che// lha chen rnams kyi gtso bo mdzad// khams gsum srid pa'i yid bsgul nas// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i re ba skongs// shin tu khros gzugs ber nag gyon// gnam lcags tho ba 'phyar zhing brdeg /sbud pa nag po drag bus nas// dgra bo tshar gcod khyod la bstod// thang pe ha ra'i gsol kha bzhugs so// kyai/ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dam tshig can// drag shul mi bzad nyams pa'i gshed// chos mdzad skyong ba'i bstan bsrung che// rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol// mchod pa ni/ kyai/ ro brgya ldan pa'i rgya ja dang*// mdangs ro bcud ldan lha'i bdud rtsir// sa yi snying por sbyar ba'i skyems// khrag gi rgya mtsho chen pos mchod// yid la brnags pa'i spyan gzigs dang*// ri ltar spungs pa'i ba ling ta// mchod rdzas rten rdzas mthun pa'i rdzas// ma tshang med pa brngan du 'bul// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// nyer 'tshe'i rgud par rgyang bsrings nas// yid la re ba'i don thams cad// myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// bstod pa ni/ kyai/ 'char
